mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that dampens equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity where demand is outpacing supply constraints, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, high consumer credit demand (RSAFS) signals overleveraged households and potential credit tightening, which suppresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when RSAFS is high, or the Rank IC for RSAFS in late-cycle regimes falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating inflation that prompts central bank tightening, reducing real equity returns and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is rising, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market and aggressive monetary policy, which together suppress equity returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising and UNRATE is falling, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and inflationary pressures, prompting central bank hawkishness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
